name: onchain-randomness
description: Explains how to generate and secure onchain randomness in Sui Move with the Random shared object at 0x8 and RandomGenerator. Use when the user asks how to generate a random number, roll dice, shuffle, draw a lottery winner, or assign a random NFT rarity in Move; mentions sui::random, Random (0x8), new_generator, generate_u128, generate_u8_in_range, generate_bytes, or shuffle; asks why a public function taking Random or RandomGenerator fails to compile; or asks about composition and abort-filtering attacks, PTB restrictions after a MoveCall consuming Random, RandomGenerator state leakage via bcs::to_bytes, commit-reveal patterns, balancing gas between winning and losing paths, or passing the Random object from TypeScript.
